name: What to Expect During Your Kitchen Island Design and Installation Timeline

step.name: Step 1: Initial Consultation and Design Planning
step.text: This phase typically takes about 2–6 weeks. It begins with our team gathering your ideas, measuring your space meticulously, and discussing your lifestyle needs. We'll explore layout options, assess appliance integration, and plan for seating, storage, and utility connections. CAD-supported layouts are developed to visualize the space and finalize specifications for cabinetry, countertops, and finishes. Your input is crucial here to ensure the design perfectly aligns with your expectations.

step.name: Step 2: Permit Coordination and Pre-Construction
step.text: This step usually spans 1–4 weeks, though local conditions can influence the duration. Once the design is approved, AKN Design Group handles the necessary permit coordination. For any changes involving plumbing, electrical, gas, or structural elements, permits are typically required. During this time, materials are ordered, and the project schedule is finalized, allowing for lead times and logistical planning. Our experience with over 10,000 jobs helps streamline this process.

step.name: Step 3: Demolition and Rough-In Work
step.text: Once permits are secured and materials begin to arrive, physical work commences. This phase involves carefully removing any existing structures and preparing the site. If your new island includes a sink, cooktop, or additional electrical outlets, rough-in plumbing and electrical work will be completed at this stage, ensuring all necessary connections are in place before cabinetry installation. Structural modifications, if required, would also occur here.

step.name: Step 4: Cabinetry and Countertop Installation
step.text: With the rough-ins complete, the custom cabinetry for your island is expertly installed. This is a critical point where our craftsmanship truly shines, ensuring precise fit and finish. Following cabinetry, templates for your chosen countertops are made, and once fabricated, they are installed. This phase significantly shapes the final look and feel of your island, requiring careful coordination and attention to detail.

step.name: Step 5: Appliance Integration and Final Finishes
step.text: The final stages bring your island to life. Appliances are integrated, ensuring seamless functionality and proper connections. Final finishes, such as lighting fixtures, backsplash tiling, and any decorative elements, are completed. Our team conducts thorough checks to confirm every detail meets our high standards and your specifications. We prioritize clear communication and a high-touch homeowner experience throughout this process.

step.name: Step 6: Final Walkthrough and Project Completion
step.text: Once all work is complete, we conduct a final walkthrough with you. This is our opportunity to ensure every aspect of your new kitchen island meets your approval and that you are completely satisfied with the transformation. It’s also where we address any final questions and confirm your understanding of your new space. This managed process, from consultation to final walkthrough, is a hallmark of the AKN Design Group approach, delivering a cohesive and beautiful result. Ready to start your kitchen island transformation? Contact AKN Design Group to begin the managed process.
